title: Siman 410
section: Fleeing from Philosophical Inquiry and Strengthening in Faith

segments.he: אָמַראִם לֹא נִמְצָא מְפרָשׁ בְּדִבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּפֵרוּשׁ שֶׁאָסוּר לוֹמַר גִּירָא
segments.en: (4.) And once on Rosh Hashana Rabbainu o.b.m. also spoke about this — about the immensity of the prohibition to study these books that explain the Torah according to the ways of the philosophers — such as the books of Ibn Ezra, and particularly the bad commentary on him called Margalis Ra'ah; and the books of the Ralbag, which are well known to all for what is written there against the holy Torah — for which a person is obligated to tear his garments when hearing G-d forbid even one such word. And so on and so forth...
